notes.note: Reviewed the combined L2 source against pinned store 8958d3e5433 and contracts 9ceeecb756b. The shared TaskReviewModule performs bounded artifact reads; person and caller-lead plan readers use the same working-state owner. Inbox confirmation is correlated by delivery key in deriveThreadView. Send records its keyed intent before effect, failures echo that key, person follow-ups remain Sent with pendingFollowUp until sent again, stale agent reply keys are refused, and a keyed reply after Send + Resolve preserves Resolved. The store-only L2 extension is an 8-line internal UUID lookup; its caller checks Task id/creation time/Project inside beforeCommit. The 9 owner suites passed all 187 tests, including real inbox and Codex-token MCP boundaries. Typecheck:server-tests and typecheck:sdk passed. Provider/UI/device/release qualification is not implied.

Reviewed the three Tasks tool definitions, registration and policy, verified-caller routes, transaction Task-incarnation guard, and commit/gate evidence verifier at the combined pinned dependencies. task_thread_reply requires deliveryKey from the owner message or list; stale keys cannot claim a follow-up and resolved deliveries stay resolved after replies. The agent never supplies Task authority or verification flags. Commit peeling rejects present blobs and absent IDs; gate reads use the existing owner and deduplicate exact tuples only within one request. Real MCP tests cover these controls, cache freshness between requests, unbound/non-lead and cross-Task refusals, with no Task status mutation. No live engine/provider journey is claimed.

L1 bounded item/content reads and structured answer/numeric summary shapes are retained. The late-failure positive fixture now uses the original person sender and the Session attempt is a negative control, matching the new shared history admission. Server-tests and SDK typechecks pass. mode is still an explicit API/SDK extension to the pure Send DTO; no new contract source was authored by L2. No hosted or capture/UI proof is implied.
